name: echidna-header
description: Auto-generates and maintains the Echidna project header block on every file — project name, branch, login, and created/updated timestamps.

echidnaHeader.login.description: Login name shown in the header block.

echidnaHeader.projectName.description: Project name shown in the header. Leave empty to use the workspace folder name.

echidnaHeader.autoInsertOnCreate.description: Automatically insert a header when a new file is created.

echidnaHeader.autoUpdateOnSave.description: Automatically refresh the 'updated' timestamp on save.

echidnaHeader.width.description: Total character width of the header block.
